name: io.mcp-hangar/hangar
title: MCP Hangar
description: Policy enforcement plane for MCP: every tool call ends in a verdict. Self-hosted, MIT.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to config.yaml declaring the upstream MCP servers and policy. Without it Hangar reads ./config.yaml, else ~/.config/mcp-hangar/config.yaml (written by `mcp-hangar init`), and refuses to start if neither exists.
